title: Americans Want AI Training and Transparency in the Workplace
discussion_signal: The relay describes rising familiarity with AI alongside lower trust in its fairness, strong demand for workplace training, and continued reliance on AI itself as a learning route. It frames preparation and transparency as missing institutional infrastructure rather than merely a knowledge deficit.
linked_research_question: How can institutions close the gap between widespread AI adoption, limited preparation, and declining confidence that AI decisions are fair?
limits: Post is a secondary relay of survey findings
Self-reported trust and knowledge do not measure actual capability or fairness
